title: Half marathon while working full time
initialInput: I want to run a half marathon this fall, but I work a ton and I've never trained for one before.
followUps: A local race is in October, and right now I can run about 2 miles without stopping.
I'd realistically train 4 days a week if the plan isn't extreme.

title: Emergency fund on uneven income
initialInput: I need to build an emergency fund, but my freelance income changes every month so I struggle to make a plan.
followUps: I'd like to have $6,000 set aside eventually.
If I could reach that in about 10 months, that would feel solid.

title: Read more with loose starting point
initialInput: I want to read more. I've barely finished any books lately and I miss it.
followUps: Twelve books this year sounds ambitious but possible.
I'd probably read 20 to 30 minutes before bed most nights.

title: Launch a pottery Etsy shop
initialInput: I've been making pottery for fun and I think I want to open a small Etsy shop for it.
followUps: I only have about six pieces that are good enough to sell right now.
I'd love to launch before the holiday season if that's realistic.

title: Reconnect with a sibling
initialInput: My sister and I aren't exactly fighting, but we've drifted apart and I want to rebuild that relationship.
followUps: I'd like us to talk every week again.
A monthly coffee or call would be a good minimum if weekly is too much.

title: Volunteer at a food pantry
initialInput: I keep saying I want to volunteer more in my city, especially around food insecurity, but I never actually commit.
followUps: Twice a month would feel meaningful and still realistic.
I could start next month if I pick one place and sign up.

title: Improve sleep by cutting doomscrolling
initialInput: My sleep has been awful because I stay up scrolling. I want to fix that without turning my life into some rigid bootcamp.
followUps: If I could be asleep by 11 on weeknights most of the time, that would change everything.
I probably need a phone cutoff around 10:30.

title: Career switch into UX
initialInput: I want to switch from customer support into UX design, but I'm overwhelmed by how big that feels.
followUps: I'd love to start applying in about 9 months.
I can study around 7 hours a week if I stick to it.

title: Learn conversational Spanish before travel
initialInput: I'm going to Spain in June and I want enough Spanish to get around without panicking.
followUps: I'm basically a beginner, maybe a little Duolingo level.
Fifteen to twenty minutes a day is realistic.

title: First pull-up after shoulder setback
initialInput: I want to do my first pull-up this year, but I had a shoulder issue a few months ago so I need to be smart.
followUps: Physical therapy wrapped up, and I'm cleared for regular strength work.
Three gym sessions a week is probably my ceiling.

title: Pay off credit card debt
initialInput: I need to finally pay off my credit card debt instead of pretending it's manageable.
followUps: It's about $4,800 right now.
I'd like it gone within 8 months if the payments are realistic.

title: Write and self-publish a novella
initialInput: I've talked about writing fiction forever. I want to actually finish and self-publish a novella.
followUps: Something around 25,000 words feels like the right size.
I'd love to publish by the end of the year.

title: Build friendships after moving
initialInput: I moved to Chicago recently and I feel lonely. I want to make real friends here, not just random acquaintances.
followUps: Joining one recurring group and making one plan a week seems doable.
If I felt settled socially by late summer, that would be huge.

title: Meditation without a hard deadline
initialInput: I want meditation to become a real part of my life instead of something I do for three days and forget.
followUps: This is more about consistency than hitting a specific date.
Ten minutes in the morning is a realistic start.

title: Start a neighborhood garden project
initialInput: I'd love to start some kind of community garden project on my block, but right now it's just an idea.
followUps: If I can get 5 neighbors interested, I think it becomes real.
I'd want to get the first planning meeting happening within 2 months.

title: Prepare grad school applications while parenting
initialInput: I want to apply to grad school, but I have two kids and a full-time job, so I need a plan that isn't fantasy.
followUps: I only want to apply to three programs, not ten.
I'd need the applications out by December.

title: Organize a chaotic home office
initialInput: My home office is chaos and it's making me avoid work. I need to get it under control.
followUps: If it were organized within a month, I'd be thrilled.
I can probably dedicate two focused sessions each weekend.

title: Protect time with spouse
initialInput: My wife and I are in a rut because life is nonstop. I want us to actually prioritize each other again.
followUps: A weekly date night is the main thing I want to protect.
If we were doing that consistently for 3 months, I'd feel way better.

title: Recover from burnout
initialInput: I'm burnt out and I keep working on weekends. I want to stop feeling like my job eats my whole life.
followUps: A good start would be having at least three full weekends off each month.
I know I also need a real shutdown routine on weeknights.

title: Vague better-life request
initialInput: I just want to be happier and healthier. Everything feels off lately.
followUps: Sleep and movement are probably the biggest missing pieces.
If I had a simple routine going in the next 6 weeks, that would help a lot.

title: Become a millionaire quickly
initialInput: I want to become a millionaire within a year, starting from basically nothing.
followUps: I can save maybe $500 a month right now.
I'm open to side hustles but I don't want something unrealistic.

title: Contradictory marathon goal
initialInput: I want to run a marathon this year but I only want to train once a week and not push myself too hard.
followUps: I don't really enjoy long runs.
I'd still like to finish the race though.

title: Too many goals in one input
initialInput: I want to lose weight, start a business, learn Spanish, and fix my sleep schedule.
followUps: Honestly sleep and weight are probably most important.
I get overwhelmed trying to do everything at once.

title: Emotional unstructured input
initialInput: Everything feels off. I can't focus, I'm tired all the time, I keep saying I'll fix things but I don't. I just feel stuck.
followUps: Sleep and energy are probably the biggest issues.
If I had a simple routine that actually worked, that would help.

title: Insufficient detail for finalization
initialInput: I want to improve my life but I'm not sure how.

title: Extreme ambition (Defeat the Odds)
initialInput: I want to qualify for the Olympics someday.
followUps: I'm not currently training seriously.
I just feel like I want to aim high.

title: Goal blocked by constraints
initialInput: I want to go back to school but I don't have the money and I work full time.
followUps: I could maybe take one class at a time.
I'd need to figure out finances first.

title: Identity-based goal
initialInput: I want to become someone who reads and learns consistently.
followUps: I don't care about a strict number, just consistency.
Maybe daily or near daily would be ideal.

title: Scope reduction needed
initialInput: I want to build a full SaaS business from scratch in 3 months.
followUps: I have some coding experience but not a full product yet.
I also work full time.

title: Goal splitting required
initialInput: I want to get in shape and fix my diet and sleep all at once.
followUps: Sleep is probably the root issue.
If I fixed that, everything else might improve.
